anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: System pressure dropped abruptly from ~649 mbar to 392 mbar at k=19 and stays ~400 mbar
Buffer-vessel dP jumped from ~2 to ~6.9 mbar coincident with pressure drop
Column dP collapsed from ~1.0 to ~0.34 mbar, indicating loss of vapour traffic
Reboiler and column temperatures fell sharply after steady climb (T705 44->32.8)
Distillate flow to ~0.005 while reflux spiked to ~1.3-1.5

args.missing_evidence: A pressure-hold/leak test with heaters held constant, and verification of vacuum-side setpoint changes in the control log, to distinguish an unannounced pressure setpoint change from a physical seal/vacuum leak.
